user.description: Configure GitHub Copilot with a fine-grained token granting Copilot Requests, or connect to the GitHub Copilot Bridge add-on. Local mode downloads the matching CLI runtime if needed. See the [documentation]({documentation_url}).

data_description.api_token: Fine-grained GitHub token with Copilot Requests permission. Not needed with a bridge URL.
data_description.model: The AI model to use for conversations. The next step shows its supported reasoning levels.
data_description.cli_url: URL of the GitHub Copilot Bridge add-on server. Leave empty to run the CLI locally.
data_description.mcp_config: JSON containing mcpServers, or a JSON file path readable by Home Assistant. Every server must include a tools list: [] disables tools, named tools restrict access, and ["*"] allows all. Selected tools run without confirmation.

reasoning.title: Reasoning effort
reasoning.description: Model: **{model}**. Runtime-reported default: **{default_effort}** (`-` means not reported). Only levels supported by this model and the installed SDK are offered. If no explicit levels are available, use Model default.

data_description.reasoning_effort: Model default sends no override. Low can reduce latency for routine home control. Unsupported selections are rejected, not silently replaced.

error.auth: Authentication failed. Please verify your GitHub token is valid and has Copilot permissions. Ensure you have an active GitHub Copilot subscription.
error.connection: Unable to connect to GitHub Copilot CLI. Please verify the Copilot CLI is installed and running (locally or via the add-on), and check the Copilot CLI URL if using the add-on.
error.invalid_url: Invalid URL. Enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS address for the Copilot Bridge add-on (for example, the add-on hostname on port 8000).
error.invalid_mcp: Provide valid mcpServers JSON or a readable Home Assistant JSON file. Every server requires an explicit tools list ([] disables tools). Check server types, URLs, headers, and tool lists.
error.token_required: GitHub Token is required when not using the Copilot Bridge add-on.
error.unsupported_reasoning_effort: This model does not support the selected reasoning effort. Choose an offered level or Model default.
error.reasoning_metadata_unavailable: Reasoning capabilities could not be retrieved. Retry, or explicitly choose Model default to leave effort controlled by the runtime.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: GitHub Copilot is already configured. Only one instance is allowed.

data_description.model: The AI model to use for conversations. The next step shows its supported reasoning levels.

reasoning.description: Model: **{model}**. Runtime-reported default: **{default_effort}** (`-` means not reported). Only levels supported by this model and the installed SDK are offered. Changes are saved only after this step.

data_description.reasoning_effort: Model default removes the override. An existing effort is preserved until you explicitly change it. Low can reduce latency for routine home control.
